remarks: Welcome to this inviting 1-bedroom unit with large windows that fill each room with warm natural light. Enjoy beautiful new floors throughout, a generous living room that can easily accommodate a desk or dining table, and a spacious bedroom offering a comfortable space to unwind. The updated, modern kitchen features expansive black granite countertops, a gas range, and abundant cabinet space for all your storage needs. Plus, a built-in breakfast nook, ideal for morning coffee or cooking with others. Woodside Green offers residents the best of both worlds: a serene, park-like setting just minutes from the shops, restaurants, and amenities of downtown Stamford. Right outside your door, enjoy Scalzi Park with its recreational fields, walking trails, and playground, as well as the Ridgeway Shopping Center, featuring favorites like Starbucks, Stop & Shop, and more. Ideal for commuters, this location provides quick access to the Merritt Pkwy, I-95, and Metro-North/Amtrak train stations. Pet-friendly complex with a common laundry room and off-street parking available. It truly has it all!
